#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long mod(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long m = mod;
    return ((a % m) + m) % m;
}

long long modPow(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modInverse(long long a, long long mod) {
    return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

vector<long long> extended_gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a == 0) return {b, 0, 1};
    auto next = extended_gcd(b % a, a);
    long long tempX = next[1];
    next[1] = next[2] - (b / a) * next[1];
    next[2] = tempX;
    return next;
}

long long inverse(long long a, long long mod) {
    auto inv = extended_gcd(a, mod);
    if (inv[0] != 1) return 0;
    else return mod(inv[1], mod);
}

long long modFraction(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long invB = inverse(b, mod);
    if (invB == 0) return -1;
    else return (invB * a) % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long N, M;
    int K;
    cin >> N >> M >> K;

    long long mod = modFraction(1, M, MOD);
    vector<long long> expect(K + 1, 0);
    expect[0] = 1;
    vector<long long> poly(K + 1, 0);
    poly[0] = 1;
    long long curExpect = 1;

    for (int k = 1; k <= K; ++k) {
        curExpect = (curExpect * mod(N - (k - 1), MOD)) % MOD;
        curExpect = (curExpect * mod) % MOD;

        for (int i = k; i >= 0; --i) {
            poly[i] = ((i > 0 ? poly[i - 1] : 0) + (-(k - 1)) * poly[i]) % MOD;
            poly[i] = mod(poly[i], MOD);
        }

        expect[k] = curExpect;
        for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            expect[k] = (expect[k] - poly[i] * expect[i]) % MOD;
            expect[k] = mod(expect[k], MOD);
        }
    }

    cout << expect[K] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
